units.source_text: 连书包也没有携带，仿佛是从这里突然被神仙隐幕起来似的，外出旅行就是我的计划。

en.t: My plan was to set out on a journey without even carrying a schoolbag, as if I had suddenly been hidden away from this place by some immortal spirit.

units.source_text: 我幻想着：我和茗帚在黎明中微微发白的沙石路上晃动。

en.t: I imagined it: the broom and I swaying on the gravel road that was faintly whitening in the dawn.

units.source_text: 突然答帚倒下，我的身影消失了，留下来的只是黎明中的白沙石路。

en.t: Suddenly the broom fell over, my figure vanished, and all that remained was the white gravel road in the dawn.
This was how I had to run away.
